purpose: Teach: 隠そ/見渡し/励ん/史跡/貧しく/苦境/途絶え/撃ち

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者は証拠を隠そうとしておりました
lines.en: In this case, the suspect was attempting to conceal evidence.
lines.style: Professional, measured delivery. Steady eye contact. The weight of facts stated plainly without drama. Voice level, slightly formal register.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察、上空から町を見渡して捜索ですね
lines.en: So the police conducted an aerial search of the town, then?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity in the question. Slight uptick on the question mark. Leaning forward slightly. Processing what he's hearing — not doubting, understanding.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、地域防犯に励んでおります
lines.en: The police department is actively engaged in regional crime prevention.
lines.style: Official tone, measured. Each phrase lands with quiet authority. Not rushed. The cadence of someone who has said this before and means it each time.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察が史跡の被害も調査されたんですね
lines.en: So the police investigated the damage to the historic sites as well?
lines.style: Careful, connecting-the-dots tone. Thoughtful pause before speaking. Not accusatory — genuinely piecing together the scope. Soft, attentive.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、貧しく困った家庭への支援も行います
lines.en: The police also provide support to families in difficult economic circumstances.
lines.style: Firm but not cold. A statement of purpose. Steady pace. The implicit: this is what we do, beyond the headlines. Grounded authority.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者は苦境にあったそうですね
lines.en: The victim was in a difficult situation, I understand.
lines.style: Quiet recognition. A small pause before speaking, as if acknowledging the weight of that. Gentle but not soft. The voice of someone registering human cost.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯人との連絡が途絶えたそうですね
lines.en: Contact with the suspect was lost at some point.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delivery. A shift to briefer information. Clinical but not unkind. The slight lift of a statement closing a chapter.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者の撃ち方、警察、解析されたんですね
lines.en: The police analysed the suspect's actions in detail, then.
lines.style: Quiet conclusion. Recognition of technical precision. Soft at the end, like a period on a sentence. Respectful of the work done, without fanfare.
